author: Cptnwhizbang
body:
Yo!

https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1KFpi0ulS5FnfFEW34h1v4G93m6ObgxXHXX6zTkM4sWk/edit?gid=66030827#gid=66030827

This spreadsheet has a list of every good ward piece for all slots for Gilga (there are multiple tabs/worksheets). 

For max ward, look for one of the new Masks from the last few events. You probably have one if you played last month's event. 

Chest, the Ragnarok event has a boss Raid that drops Fey Surtr's chest. This is your goal.

Legs look good - there are other options too.

Shield is fine - look for a Spiked Greatshield from the Rhada event. It's very farmable via kingdom raids and gives more SS3 damage.

Weapon is good. Beguiled Axe X is also fantastic and you should get one next time Apollyon rolls around.

author: regrt1
body:
If you are coming from Diety, I did the same, could I suggest G.Ursa instead?  Its very similar to D.Ursa play style, but you can maximize Collateral damage to see what a difference it makes between the 2 classes.  You can get most of the t.att buffs with spells and equipment to match d.ursa, so main damage is slightly lower but with collateral damage it brings it to a similar if not higher numbers.    
  

  
  
Make a crit 2-handed build with 100% collateral damage.  With this event get all the Pendragon armor and an Excalibur 2-hander.  They don't have to be all ornate, but its nicer, esp Excalibur.  The bonus aren't really affected from quality.
